description: RAPTOR Codex lifecycle hooks; active only for launcher-owned sessions.

hooks.command: if [ -n "${RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT-}" ]; then case "$RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT" in /*) cd -- "$RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT" || { echo "RAPTOR: launcher installation unavailable; restart through bin/raptor --codex" >&2; exit 1; };; *) echo "RAPTOR: invalid launcher hook root; restart through bin/raptor --codex" >&2; exit 1;; esac; python3 -I "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" session-start; fi

if [ -n "${RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT-}" ]; then case "$RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT" in /*) cd -- "$RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT" || { echo "RAPTOR: launcher installation unavailable; restart through bin/raptor --codex" >&2; exit 1; };; *) echo "RAPTOR: invalid launcher hook root; restart through bin/raptor --codex" >&2; exit 1;; esac; python3 -I "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" stop; fi

if [ -n "${RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT-}" ]; then case "$RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT" in /*) cd -- "$RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT" || { echo "RAPTOR: launcher installation unavailable; restart through bin/raptor --codex" >&2; exit 1; };; *) echo "RAPTOR: invalid launcher hook root; restart through bin/raptor --codex" >&2; exit 1;; esac; python3 -I "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" subagent-start; fi

if [ -n "${RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT-}" ]; then case "$RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT" in /*) cd -- "$RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT" || { echo "RAPTOR: launcher installation unavailable; restart through bin/raptor --codex" >&2; exit 1; };; *) echo "RAPTOR: invalid launcher hook root; restart through bin/raptor --codex" >&2; exit 1;; esac; python3 -I "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" end; fi

if [ -n "${RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT-}" ]; then case "$RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT" in /*) cd -- "$RAPTOR_CODEX_HOOK_ROOT" || { echo "RAPTOR: launcher installation unavailable; restart through bin/raptor --codex" >&2; exit 1; };; *) echo "RAPTOR: invalid launcher hook root; restart through bin/raptor --codex" >&2; exit 1;; esac; python3 -I "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch.py" outcome; fi
